headline: Last session: Sensex drops 570 points amid foreign selloff; markets closed today for Gandhi Jayanti.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: En-masse selling by foreign institutional investors eroding equity market valuation.
Broad-based losses marking the benchmark indices' eighth consecutive week of decline.
Weakness in top losing equities including Bajaj Auto and Max Health.
Negative sentiment driven by ongoing domestic and global market pressure.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE are closed today, 2 October 2026, in observance of Gandhi Jayanti.
In the last session, Sensex dropped 570.59 points while Nifty tanked to 22,421.95.
Foreign investor sell-off wiped out nearly Rs 9 lakh crore of market capitalization.
Carlsberg India unit and three other companies received SEBI approval to proceed with IPOs.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the Gandhi Jayanti holiday. In the previous trading session, the benchmark indices suffered steep losses as Sensex dropped 570 points amid heavy foreign investor selling. The market wrapped up its eighth consecutive week of decline.
